name: @clayver/firebase-tests
description: Firebase Emulator Suite tests for Clayver's rules and Cloud Functions.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @clayver/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-clayver --only auth,database,storage,functions "vitest run"
scripts.emulators: pnpm --filter @clayver/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-clayver --only auth,database,storage,functions "node ../scripts/load-emulator-rules.mjs && node -e \"setInterval(() => {}, 1 << 30)\""
